title: Label
description: Structure informed by the ASTM D8449 label module architecture (summary source; not a conformance claim, standard text not reproduced). All modules are optional in core — a jurisdiction profile requires specific subsets and adds constraints such as a state-mandated warning sticker.

pdp.description: Principal Display Panel: identity, net quantity, high-level cannabinoid summary.

cannabinoid_facts.description: Potency panel: analyte breakdown plus serving math. cannabinoids here is a display copy of LabResult.cannabinoids; LabResult is authoritative. When they disagree, LabResult wins.

cannabinoids.description: Display copy only. Source of truth is LabResult.cannabinoids.

warnings.description: Health/safety statements. State-mandated wording is a profile constraint, not core content.

identity_compliance.description: License numbers, manufacturer/processor identity, lot/batch, packaging date, track-and-trace. lot here uses the Identifier shape (one of three lot/batch representations in core). See LabResult.batch_lot (string) and Package.gtin (no lot carried; scheme=gtin only). Lot vs Batch terminology is intentionally left open.

lot.description: Lot/batch identifier using the Identifier shape. One of three lot/batch shapes; see LabResult.batch_lot (string) and Package.gtin (no lot). Lot vs Batch is left open.

optional.description: Terpenes, full ingredients, storage/disposal, COA QR access.

coa_qr_url.description: Display/QR convenience only. Source of truth is LabResult.public_url. When they disagree, LabResult wins.

intoxicating_symbol.description: Whether an intoxicating-cannabinoid product symbol (see ASTM D8441) is required on this label, and where. This carries a reference, not the symbol artwork.
